def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    # Find an L-shaped, thin component to use as the color key.
    guides = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        rs = [p[0] for p in cells]
        cs = [p[1] for p in cells]
        top, bottom, left, right = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
        height, width = bottom - top + 1, right - left + 1
        if height < 2 or width < 2:
            continue
        # Prefer components with long, thin horizontal and vertical arms.
        horizontal = max(sum(1 for r, c in cells if r == y) for y in range(top, bottom + 1))
        vertical = max(sum(1 for r, c in cells if c == x) for x in range(left, right + 1))
        if horizontal >= 3 and vertical >= 3 and len(cells) <= height + width + 3:
            guides.append((len(cells), color, cells, top, bottom, left, right))

    if not guides:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    _, key_color, guide, top, bottom, left, right = min(guides)

    # The open quadrant of the L is opposite its two arms. Use the elbow
    # and arm directions to identify that quadrant.
    guide_set = set(guide)
    elbow = None
    for r, c in guide:
        horiz = any((r, x) in guide_set for x in range(c - 1, c + 2) if x != c)
        vert = any((y, c) in guide_set for y in range(r - 1, r + 2) if y != r)
        if horiz and vert:
            elbow = (r, c)
            break
    if elbow is None:
        elbow = (bottom if top < bottom else top, right if left < right else left)
    er, ec = elbow

    # Determine which directions the arms extend from the elbow.
    arm_dirs = []
    for dy, dx in ((-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)):
        if (er + dy, ec + dx) in guide_set:
            arm_dirs.append((dy, dx))
    # For the common L case, the target is in the quadrant opposite the arms.
    up = any(dy == -1 for dy, dx in arm_dirs)
    down = any(dy == 1 for dy, dx in arm_dirs)
    left_arm = any(dx == -1 for dy, dx in arm_dirs)
    right_arm = any(dx == 1 for dy, dx in arm_dirs)
    want_up = down and not up
    want_down = up and not down
    want_left = right_arm and not left_arm
    want_right = left_arm and not right_arm

    candidates = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        if color == key_color:
            continue
        if want_up and not any(r < er for r, c in cells):
            continue
        if want_down and not any(r > er for r, c in cells):
            continue
        if want_left and not any(c < ec for r, c in cells):
            continue
        if want_right and not any(c > ec for r, c in cells):
            continue
        dist = min(abs(r - er) + abs(c - ec) for r, c in cells)
        candidates.append((dist, color, cells))

    if not candidates:
        candidates = [
            (min(abs(r-er) + abs(c-ec) for r, c in cells), color, cells)
            for color, cells in comps if color != key_color
        ]
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    _, target_color, target = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in target:
        out[r][c] = key_color
    return out
